checks.name: backend pytest suite (test_tscheck_admin_catalog_crud.py, test_tscheck_catalog_integrity.py, test_tscheck_session_isolation.py)
checks.evidence: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider (fixed -n2 --dist loadscope): 9 passed, run 3 consecutive times with no failures (previously the full-suite run failed test_admin_cannot_see_own_qa_named_product intermittently). Fixed test isolation: added a cross-worker filelock-backed `admin_account_lock` fixture in conftest.py, applied to the shared `admin_client` fixture and to the raw-client admin-password-reset test in test_tscheck_admin_catalog_crud.py, so any test that logs in as or mutates the single seeded admin account now serializes across xdist workers and can no longer invalidate another worker's in-flight admin session. Also confirmed via code inspection that routers/products.py (lines 55, 131-132) already exempts authenticated admins from the public QA-title regex, so the underlying visibility behavior needed no application change; updated stale 'BUG'-framed docstrings/messages in the two test files to reflect the fixed state.

notes: All 5 current SAFYRA brand acceptance criteria re-verified passing via re-run of the 6 persisted browser checks from iteration 17 (no script changes needed). Per seed_facts/spec_deviations, root-caused and fixed the previously reported full-suite-only backend failure as a test-isolation race (not an app defect): test_tscheck_admin_catalog_crud.py mutates/invalidates the shared seeded admin's sessions while test_tscheck_catalog_integrity.py's admin_client fixture (running concurrently on another pytest-xdist worker under --dist loadscope) could get caught mid-invalidation. Added a filelock-backed admin_account_lock fixture in conftest.py used by admin_client and the raw admin-password-reset test to serialize all shared-admin-account access across workers, without touching pytest.ini addopts or any application code. Verified 3 consecutive full-suite runs: 9/9 passed each time. Removed a stray functional-colors-whatsapp-preserved.mjs.backup file left in the checks directory.
